entry.title: Jazz Chisholm: Jazz Chisholm Jr. is in agreement with the #BlueJays The deal, per source, is 1-year, $18.5 mill. It comes with both a player and team opt for '28. Chisholm has a 16 million player option for 2028. The Jays could trigger a $40 million team option, if PO is declined. There is a $1.5 mill buyout Y2.

Toronto Blue Jays offseason notes: More on this: Don’t believe the #BlueJays’ interest in Morejon has dissipated after signing Kaima Taira yesterday. Still obviously multiple other teams said to be in on the top LHRP FA, though, and the Jays also need some bats.
